items.text: INkosi yakhuluma kuMose enkangala yaseSinayi ethenteni lokuhlangana, ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesibili, ngomnyaka wesibili emva kokuphuma kwabo eGibithe, yathi:
Balani inani lebandla lonke labakoIsrayeli ngensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, lilobe amabizo abo bonke abesilisa ngamunye ngamunye.
Bonke abakoIsrayeli abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi, wena loAroni lizakubabala ngamabandla abo.
Thathani kuleso lalesosizwe indoda eyodwa, eyinhloko yendlu, ilisize.
Nanka amabizo amadoda azakulisiza.
KoRubeni: uElizuri indodana kaShedewuri.
KoSimeyoni: uShelumiyeli indodana kaZurishadayi.
KoJuda: uNashoni indodana kaAminadaba.
KoIsakari: uNethaneli indodana kaZuwari.
KoZebuluni: uEliyabi indodana kaHeloni.
Kubantwana bakaJosefa, koEfrayimi: uElishama indodana kaAmihudi; koManase; uGamaliyeli indodana kaPedazuri.
KoBenjamini: uAbidani indodana kaGideyoni.
KoDani: uAhiyezeri indodana kaAmishadayi.
KoAsheri: uPagiyeli indodana kaOkirani.
KoGadi: uEliyasafi indodana kaDehuweli.
KoNafitali: uAhira indodana kaEnani.
Yibo abakhethwa ebandleni, beyizikhulu zezizwe zabokhokho babo lezinhloko zensendo zabo.
UMose loAroni basebethatha lawomadoda akhethiweyo.

Ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga yesibili bahlanganisa lonke ibandla; abantu batsho ukuthi ngobani okhokho babo ngensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise; kwabhalwa amabizo abo bonke abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu.
Njengokulaya kweNkosi uMose wababala enkangala yaseSinayi.

Lapho abantu bakoRubeni, izibulo likaIsrayeli, bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoRubeni lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lesithupha, lamakhulu amahlanu.
Lapho abantu bakoSimeyoni bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi.
Inani labo esizweni sakoSimeyoni lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amahlanu lesificamunwemunye, lamakhulu amathathu.
Lapho abantu bakoGadi bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoGadi lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lanhlanu, lamakhulu ayisithupha, lamatshumi amahlanu.
Lapho abantu bakoJuda bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoJuda lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisikhombisa lane, lamakhulu ayisithupha.
Lapho abantu bakoIsakari bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoIsakari lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amahlanu lane, lamakhulu amane.
Lapho abantu bakoZebuluni bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoZebuluni lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amahlanu lesikhombisa, lamakhulu amane.

Lapho abantu bakoJosefa, ngitsho abantu bakoEfrayimi, bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoEfrayimi lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lamakhulu amahlanu.
Lapho abantu bakoManase bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoManase lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amathathu lambili, lamakhulu amabili.
Lapho abantu bakoBenjamini bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoBenjamini lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amathathu lanhlanu, lamakhulu amane.
Lapho abantu bakoDani bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoDani lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi ayisithupha lambili, lamakhulu ayisikhombisa.
Lapho abantu bakoAsheri bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoAsheri lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amane lanye, lamakhulu amahlanu.
Lapho abantu bakoNafitali bebalwa ngezizukulwana zabo langensendo zabo langezindlu zaboyise, kwagwalwa wonke amabizo abesilisa abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphumi impi;
inani labo esizweni sakoNafitali lalizinkulungwane ezingamatshumi amahlanu lantathu, lamakhulu amane.
Yibo labo ababalwa nguMose loAroni besizwa yizikhulu zakoIsrayeli ezilitshumi lambili, yileso laleso isikhulu simele isizwe.
Kwabalwa bonke abakoIsrayeli abaleminyaka engamatshumi amabili lengaphezulu, abangaphuma impi, ngezindlu zaboyise;
babezinkulungwane ezingamakhulu ayisithupha lantathu, lamakhulu amahlanu, lamatshumi amahlanu.
Kodwake amaLevi kawabalwanga ngezindlu zabokhokho bawo.
INkosi yathi kuMose:
Isizwe sakoLevi ungasibali, futhi ungabali inani laso phakathi kwabantu bakoIsrayeli;
kodwa abeke amaLevi ukukhonza eTabernakeleni lobufakazi, lokulondoloza yonke impahla yalo lakho konke okwalo. Azathwala
layo yonke impahla yalo, alilondoloze, amise amathente awo ukuze alizingelezele.
Ekusukeni kweTabernakeli amaLevi azakulidiliza, njalo ekumisweni kwalo amaLevi alimise. Uba kusondela kulo omunye umuntu, uzakubulawa.
Abantu bakoIsrayeli bazakumisa amathente abo ngamabandla abo, kube yilabo lalabo ezihonqweni zakhe, ngaphansi kophawu lwakhe.
Kodwa amaLevi azakumisa amathente awo alizingelezele iTabernakeli lobufakazi, ukuba kungehleli ulaka lukaNkulunkulu phezu kwalo lonke ibandla lakoIsrayeli; amaLevi azakulondoloza
Abantu bakoIsrayeli benza njalo njengakho konke iNkosi eyayimlaye khona uMose.
